sentences.en: Give me a reading on that meter near the boiler.
sentences.zh: 请给我读一下锅炉附近的那个仪表的数值。

sentences.en: I forgot to turn on the boiler before taking a shower.
sentences.zh: 我在洗澡前忘了打开锅炉了。

sentences.en: I'm afraid I got too carried away throwing passengers into the boiler.
sentences.zh: 恐怕我一时冲动把乘客扔进了锅炉里。

senses.zh: 锅炉；烧水壶，热水器；盛热水器
